title: Document wake holds across failed Stop, pause and Engram grant retirement
outcome: The wake failure feature brief describes factual Accepted/Unknown settlement under a retained pause, failed requested Stop, explicit Stop recovery and logical-wake retention after rejected grant retirement.
acceptance: docs/features/wake-failure-recovery.md explains that failed Stop does not consume an Accepted/Unknown wake, preserves pause and reconciliation hold, and identifies Stop as the explicit cancellation path before resuming.

The brief distinguishes retiring an exhausted Engram grant from consuming the wake: the same positively rejected wake requires fresh write-ahead and authorization at the next eligible admission; it also states that runtime exit preserves independent operator pause.
